Role-based access controls let administrators limit who can see which workspace. We publish product updates every two weeks. Customer content may be used to improve our models unless an administrator turns off 'Help improve Nibbhub Labs' in workspace settings.

Penetration tests are performed annually by an independent firm.

title: Nibbhub Labs Trust Center

Nibbhub Labs Trust Center

We publish product updates every two weeks. Access to production systems requires hardware security keys.

Our standard Data Processing Agreement is published on our legal page and applies to every customer automatically.
